title: Bathroom Tiling quote, real prices, under a minute
jobDescription:
Bathroom Tiling Renovation, small ensuite.
Scope:
- Floor Tiling: 4.5 square metres.
- Wall Tiling: 8.3 square metres.
  - Comprising: Shower recess (three walls) tiled to ceiling height (2.4 metres); Vanity splashback wall tiled to 1.2 metres height.
- Tile Supply:
  - Floor Tiles: 300x300mm porcelain, standard grade.
  - Wall Tiles: 300x600mm ceramic, standard grade.
- Waterproofing: Full bathroom floor and shower recess walls (up to 1.8 metres high).
- Materials: Flexible tile adhesive, matching coloured grout, standard aluminium tile trim, mould-resistant silicone.
- Waste calculations included.
- Exclusions: Demolition of existing tiles, screeding (assumed level substrate).
workingDetail: Floor tiles, Wall tiles, Tile adhesive (flexible), Grout (matching colour)
